tools.name: search
tools.description: Search startups, people with an idea and communities in Romania and Moldova. Answers with a list of results, each with an id to fetch, a title and a url to cite.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: A startup's, person's or community's page as Markdown, by the id a search gave.

tools.name: propose_change
tools.description: Add a startup or a community to builtin.ro, or change one, for the person you're helping. Checked as the site's forms check it; then a code is emailed to the person's address, which must be on the startup's or community's own domain. Nothing goes live until confirm_change gets that code. tools.name: confirm_change
tools.description: Publishes what propose_change checked, once the person gives you the 6-digit code from their email. Answers with the page's URL.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search, propose_change · Public sink: propose_change, confirm_change.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search, propose_change · Public sink: propose_change, confirm_change

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
